name: Sano Ikumi
source:
A student who is good friends with Chiaki. She addresses herself as “boku” and and exudes an androgynous aura.
Currently a member of the swimming club. She appears in front of Chiaki to try to persuade her to return to the swim team after Chiaki has withdrawn from the club for some reason.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/hkgie/character.html]offical character page[/url]]
